title: A voice over your own music
description: Short cues are audible, and after them the music comes back to its previous volume.

blocks.text: Even a good plan is irritating if every phrase interrupts your usual listening for a long stretch.

quote.text: I am not happy whenever i am using the app and the voice comes on to tell me "i'm half way through", my music volume reduces significantly and i won't be able to increase it till i'm done using the app at that moment. This experience affects my run experience significantly and i'm not happy

blocks.text: Offer a trial with headphones and your own music app, a choice of voice and of how often cues come. Test the return of the sound after a cue separately.
The settings have to apply to the real listening setup, not only to a demo clip.
